statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail returns to the low band because the session low held through the power hour and the cash close while volatility, both yield tenors and crude all closed below their session highs.
recommendation: Tail at 18 maps to EA_ON, four points below the previous hour, because the 19:00Z to 20:30Z danger window published last hour elapsed without the 30,556.40 low failing. The narrow danger window now shifts to 23:00Z to 02:00Z, covering the Tokyo and Seoul cash opens that price the OpenAI revenue revision and today's semiconductor decline for the first time. A chip-led Asian gap that extends without retracement is the stated invalidation of this reading. Existing-position management and protective logic are unaffected by this mapped state.
headline: Session low holds into the cash close as volatility, yields and crude all retreat from their highs, returning Tail to the low band against still-elevated Stress
body:
The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed at 30,725.81, down 434.27 points or 1.39%, inside a 30,556.40 to 31,125.13 session range against a 31,160.08 previous close and a 30,985.23 open. Nasdaq-100 December futures, the preferred continuous reference, are at 30,995.50, down 1.30%, with a 30,792.50 session low. The decisive observation for this hour is that the low set near 17:20Z held through the power hour and the 20:00Z cash close: the index settled 169.41 points, about 0.55%, above it and the futures some 203 points above theirs. No fresh session extreme printed into the close, which is the explicit invalidation condition from the previous hour failing to trigger. Under this provider's contract a held low with a visible bounce is a completed retracement inside a range, not the repeated extension after failed retracements that constitutes Tail evidence.

Every amplifier that drove the earlier block-band hour has now partly unwound. Implied volatility is the clearest signal: the VIX closed at 15.41, up only 0.33 or 2.19% on a day the Nasdaq-100 fell 1.39%, and it did so having retreated from a 16.46 session high toward its 15.15 low. An index down nearly one and a half percent with a sub-16 VIX is not pricing a disorderly path. The ten-year Treasury yield closed at 5.23, down five basis points on the day, near its 5.22 session low, ten basis points below the 5.33 session high and some twelve below the 5.356 twenty-four-year high reached on October 7. The two-year sits near 4.75, below the 4.77 level the Federal Reserve H.15 release records for October 7. That easing is notable because it followed, rather than preceded, the week's principal supply test: the 17:00Z thirty-year auction sold 22 billion dollars at 5.618%, well above the 5.308% of the prior sale and the highest such clearing level in decades. Demand was adequate rather than poor, with indirect bidders taking 72.3% against a ten-auction average near 68%, while direct participation at 20.9% ran modestly below its 22% average and the bid-to-cover eased to about 2.5 from 2.6. A high-yield but adequately covered sale that is followed by lower yields is a cleared event, not an unresolved one.

Crude tells the same story of a fading impulse. West Texas Intermediate is at 90.87, up 2.59 or 2.93%, but 2.33 dollars below its 93.20 session high, and Brent pared from roughly 104.60 to about 103. The fade is directly attributable to a Truth Social post published near 17:02Z in which President Trump stated that the United States will not attack Iran at any time prior to the November 3 midterm elections, describing talks with Tehran as productive while confirming that the blockade remains in force. That matters disproportionately for this assessment because a surprise strike and the consequent energy discontinuity is the single most credible mechanism for the pathological one-way path this provider scores. That mechanism has now been explicitly deferred past the entire twenty-four-hour forecast window. The conflict itself is unresolved and the blockade persists, so the statement reduces the probability of a discontinuity without removing it.

The session's actual driver was a cross-sectional de-rating rather than an index-level collapse, and the distinction is the core of this hour's reading. A Financial Times report published near 17:40Z said OpenAI had told investors its annualized revenue approached 50 billion dollars at the end of September, roughly 20 billion below the 70 billion figure widely reported late last month and below Anthropic's 65 billion. The semiconductor and AI-supply-chain complex absorbed that: the semiconductor gauge fell as much as 4% before trimming, with Arm, Intel and Marvell each down more than 6% at their worst, Micron off more than 5%, Intel at 107.08 down 5.34%, Oracle down 4.9%, Celestica down 5.9%, Advanced Micro Devices down 3.3%, Broadcom down 3.2% and Nvidia at 230.48 down 2.94%. Against that, the Dow Jones Industrial Average closed higher, up 51.77 points or 0.10% at 51,231.64, while the S&P 500 fell only 0.47% and the Nasdaq Composite 1.25%. Capital rotated within the market rather than leaving it. Breadth that diverges this clearly is the opposite of the aligned confirmation this contract requires before Tail is amplified, and it is the primary reason Tail sits at 18 rather than in the watch band.

The macro data was unthreatening. Initial jobless claims for the week ended October 3 came in at 197,000 against a 200,000 consensus and a 199,000 prior, with continuing claims at 1,716,000 and the four-week average at 198,000. Wholesale inventories rose 0.5% against 0.7% expected and the Atlanta Fed GDPNow estimate for the third quarter stands at 3.6%. Bitcoin fell about 2% to near 81,000 dollars, a mild risk signal rather than a stress event.

Stress eases three points to 65 but remains in the high band, and the gap between a low Tail and a high Stress is the honest description of this tape. The ten-year near 5.23 and a thirty-year auction clearing at 5.618% represent a genuinely difficult rate environment; crude near 91 dollars with an active Middle East conflict and a standing blockade is a live inflation channel; and the AI complex is repricing on a fundamental revenue revision rather than on sentiment. September CPI on October 14 and the combined PPI and Retail Sales release on October 15 will test all of it. None of that is the same as a price path that denies mean reversion, which is what the action score measures.

The named forward checkpoint is the Asian handover. Tokyo and Seoul open at 00:00Z and will price the OpenAI revision and the US chip decline for the first time, in cash markets whose semiconductor weight is far higher than the Nasdaq-100's. The published forecast therefore holds Tail at 19 for the 23:00Z pre-open and 21 across 00:00Z and 01:00Z, with the danger window set at 23:00Z to 02:00Z, before returning to the low band as the handover path becomes observable. The second checkpoint is Friday's 13:30Z US cash open followed at 14:00Z by preliminary University of Michigan consumer sentiment and inflation expectations, both high impact, which places a two-stage whipsaw risk inside the 14:00Z slot and lifts it to 21. Confidence holds at 88: this is a post-close assessment with the complete cash-session price path, verified index, futures, volatility, yield, crude and auction levels, both material catalysts confirmed against primary reporting and a verified forward calendar. The shared Finviz context file was read and not used, because its latest publication carries a September 29 collection timestamp and a partial collection status, which places it far outside the ninety-minute freshness contract; independent research covers the same ground.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours began with a quiet mean-reverting overnight tape: Tail decayed from 13 at 20:00Z on October 7 to a cycle low of 10 at 03:00Z while Stress held a 47 to 51 range. From 06:00Z the crude and long-end-yield impulse took over, Tail stepping to 22 at 07:00Z and then holding a 20 to 23 watch-band range through the European and early US session as Stress climbed from 55 to a 59 to 66 plateau. The 14:00Z slot eased to 17 on an orderly US cash open before 15:00Z and 16:00Z returned to 20 and 22. The single block-band hour in the window is 17:00Z at Tail 28 and Stress 72, published as the thirty-year auction cleared at 5.618%, the OpenAI revenue report landed and crude reached its 93.20 high. The final two hours, 21 and 22, held the watch band through the power hour with Stress at 67 and 68. All 24 slots are available from published Claude history and are preserved as originally assessed.
outlookSummary: The forecast returns Tail to the low band at 18 for the 20:00Z post-close hour and eases to 17 through 22:00Z, because the danger window published last hour elapsed without the session low failing and because every amplifier closed below its session high. The named overnight checkpoint is the Asian handover: 23:00Z is held at 19 for the Tokyo pre-open and 00:00Z and 01:00Z are lifted to 21 because Tokyo and Seoul price the OpenAI revenue revision and today's semiconductor decline for the first time, with a chip-led gap that extends without retracement as the stated escalation mechanism. The danger window is 23:00Z to 02:00Z. Risk then decays to a cycle trough of 16 between 05:00Z and 06:00Z and again from 10:00Z to 11:00Z, stepping to 18 across the 07:00Z and 08:00Z European open on thin-liquidity gap risk. The Friday US sequence carries two checkpoints: 13:00Z is held at 19 because it contains the 13:30Z cash open, where observed opening-auction continuation would be meaningful Tail evidence, and 14:00Z is lifted to 21 for the high-impact preliminary Michigan sentiment and inflation-expectations release landing on an unsettled opening tape. The window closes at 18 for the Friday power hour, reflecting late continuation or reversal risk and weekend positioning during an active Middle East conflict in which only pre-midterm US strikes have been ruled out. Stress eases from 65 to a 61 to 62 trough and stays in the elevated-to-high range throughout, because the rate and energy backdrop is unchanged while no scheduled mechanism for a persistent one-way path exists inside the window.
